sentences.text: 2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with Shahjahanpur P.S. Case No. 70 of 2024 for the offence under Sections 376 and 457 of the Indian Penal Code and sections 25(1-b)a, and 26 of the Arms Act, lodged on 04.06.2024 by the informant, Priya Kumari.

3. Issue notice to the opposite party no.2 through both processes i.e. ordinary as well as registered cover with A/D for which requisites etc. must be filed within a period of two weeks failing which the application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.

4. In case, the order passed is not complied and the matter accordingly stands dismissed,
subsequently, the same be posted under the heading 'To be Mentioned'.

In the meantime, call for legible xerox/carbon copy of the case diary as also the statement of the victim girl from the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Patna City, Patna, in connection with Shahjahanpur P.S. Case No. 70 of 2024.
